presentation.creditsNotice: BC Sans and the display typeface are self-hosted with their open licence notices. Visual identity and public-release approval remain separate.
presentation.aboutLead: A helpful place to understand B.C. services and prepare your next step. This is a pilot, not a released government transaction service.
presentation.aboutIdentity: The pilot pairs BC Sans with an open-licensed display serif and B.C. Design System colours. Its British Columbia photographs are from Unsplash. The British Columbia logo and favicon were supplied for this project. Public release approvals remain separate.
presentation.howIntro: This pilot brings a few everyday B.C. services into one approachable place. No account to create. No applications submitted for you. Just a helpful place to start.
presentation.sourceScene: Find information from official B.C. services, with sources you can open and check for yourself.
